e: From Japanese 女形 (おんながた, onnagata), a compound of 女 (おんな, onna, “woman”) + 形 (かた, kata, “form”).

q: "Next thing I know you're onna ground, bloody. I don't know what come over me. You goin' out?" Lenny asked.
Mal said, “How you doing then?” “Me? I'm onna dole, mate. I'm onna street.”
